description: This file defines the PaymentModule interface with method signatures related to payment processing, including transaction initialization, authorization, capture, refund, and configuration validation within an e-commerce context.

classes.name: PaymentModule
classes.description: Interface defining methods for payment processing modules, including transaction initialization, authorization, capture, refund, and configuration validation.

methods.name: validateModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the payment module configuration with given integration settings for a specific merchant store.

methods.name: initTransaction
methods.description: Initializes a transaction, typically for payment gateway tokenization, invoked during PayPal Express checkout.

methods.name: authorize
methods.description: Performs an authorization transaction for a list of shopping cart items.

methods.name: capture
methods.description: Captures funds for an authorized transaction related to an order.

methods.name: authorizeAndCapture
methods.description: Performs authorization and capture in a single step for a set of shopping cart items.

methods.name: refund
methods.description: Processes a refund for a transaction, with option for partial refunds.
